table.name: TLGNC_IMAGE
table.description: Stores images which are configurable by the administrator. Example: logos for output documents. Signatures are stored in a seperate table.

column.name: IMAGE_NAME
column.description: Human readable name/description of the image. This is used as an alternative identifier and must also be unique.

column.name: DATA
column.description: The binary data of the image

column.name: DATA_MIME_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_mime_type_bs. The MIME type of the image, 1=image/gif, 2=image/jpeg, ...
